About

The Brooklyn Dispatch exists to help readers discover culture worth spending time with.

It covers film, books and the places they lead, with criticism and recommendations designed to open doors rather than close conversations.

Contributors

The publication is edited by Steve Berkowitz, with room to grow into a broader group of contributors over time.

Editor

Steve Berkowitz

Steve writes about international cinema, books, physical media and the ways one cultural obsession tends to lead to another.
